cards.answer: Un disastro: il volo è stato cancellato.
cards.notes: So, how was the trip? / A disaster: the flight was cancelled.

cards.answer: Abbiamo dormito in un albergo vicino all'aeroporto.
cards.notes: Really? And what did you do? / We slept in a hotel near the airport.

cards.answer: Eravamo a una festa di amici comuni.
cards.notes: How did you meet? / We were at a party of mutual friends.

cards.prompt: Cosa stavi facendo quando è successo?
cards.answer: Stavo tornando a casa in bici.
cards.notes: What were you doing when it happened? / I was cycling home.

cards.answer: E poi, all'improvviso, ha cominciato a piovere.
cards.notes: And then? / And then, all of a sudden, it started to rain.

cards.answer: Un po', ma per fortuna non è successo niente.
cards.notes: Were you scared? / A bit, but luckily nothing happened.

cards.answer: Quando sono uscita, l'autobus era già passato.
cards.notes: Why didn't you come yesterday? / When I left, the bus had already gone.
What was the city like? / Beautiful, there were lights everywhere.

cards.prompt: Ti ricordi la prima volta che sei stata in Italia?
cards.answer: Sì, avevo vent'anni ed ero con mia sorella.
cards.notes: Do you remember the first time you were in Italy? / Yes, I was twenty and I was with my sister.

cards.prompt: Che cosa ti ha colpito di più?
cards.notes: What struck you most? / How kind people were.
How did it end? / In the end we all laughed.

cards.answer: Eppure è vero, te lo giuro.
cards.notes: I don't believe it. / And yet it's true, I swear.
